trigger: Prometheus target UP falsely clearing runtime integrity alerts while trading engine is stopped
root_cause: Offline metrics exporter projecting historical saved state without checking live engine state (emitting broker_connected=1 and health=ok while the engine is actually stopped).
verified_remedy: In stopped/audit mode, emit engine_state stopped, engine_health stopped, broker_connected 0, audit_mode 1, and explicit audit_snapshot_age_seconds, keeping target UP without falsely clearing runtime alerts.
limitations: Monitoring scrape reflects exporter health, not live trading connectivity; stopped mode alerts remain active by design.
